issue.body:

body:
As a temporary workaround instead of using

```
if ($form->isValid()) {
  ...
```

you can use

```
if (($form->isValid() || true) && sizeof($form->getErrors()) == 0) {
  ...
```

@ccapndave no you can't, unless you make all your errors bubble to the root form (which means your user don't know what is invalid anymore). `getErrors` does not return the errors attached to child forms
Ah, blast.  If I recurse through the children checking for `getErrors()` would this strategy be a valid workaround?

issue.title: [Form] PATCH'ed forms never submit childs
issue.body:
I'm trying to use form with $clearMissing = false but form never returns true to isValid().
This because on line https://github.com/symfony/symfony/blob/master/src/Symfony/Component/Form/Form.php#L541 we submit child when the values passed are to the form or when $clearMissing == true.

This way every child fails in the validation stage here: https://github.com/symfony/symfony/blob/master/src/Symfony/Component/Form/Form.php#L705 so the main form is never valid.
